# PawPawCare

> PawPawCare is a free pet health app for iOS and Android that keeps every pet's vaccinations, medications, weight trends, and vet records in one place — with reminders, AI-powered vet-record scanning, shareable read-only links for vets and pet sitters, family sharing, and a community for pet owners. It is currently in early access: joining the waitlist at https://pawpawcare.app/ gets a free preview invite.

## What PawPawCare does

- Multi-pet profiles: track dogs, cats, and other pets in one household account
- Vaccination tracker with due-soon reminders; mark boosters administered at the clinic
- Medication schedules with dose logging
- Weight history translated into plain-language trend insights (e.g. "Up 0.8 kg (20%) over the last 3 months") with a non-diagnostic nudge when a change is worth a vet visit
- Medical records vault: clinics, appointments, and uploaded documents (photos and PDFs)
- AI document intake: photograph a vaccination card, prescription, or invoice and the app extracts vaccines, medications, weights, and costs for review — nothing is saved without the owner's approval
- Vet share links: expiring, revocable, read-only web links a veterinarian can open in any browser without an account
- Caretaker mode: a time-limited handoff page for pet sitters with feeding notes, medication schedules, and an emergency contact
- Family sharing: co-own pets with household members
- Community feed and lost-pet alerts that notify nearby owners

## Key facts

- Platforms: iOS and Android (pre-launch; early-access preview via waitlist)
- Price: the preview is free; core tracking stays free after launch, with some power features planned for a paid plan
- Privacy: user data is never sold; share links are opt-in, time-limited, and revocable; scanned documents are processed for extraction only and not used to train AI models
- Website: https://pawpawcare.app/
- Privacy policy: https://pawpawcare.app/privacy/
- Contact: privacy@pawpawcare.app
